kind: nine complete seven-file nested game graphics/engine packages; exact-tree static source-vetting grades
macro_findings: All nine first-class package trees contain one SKILL.md and six bundled references, with complete exact Git tree and blob identities; references are not additional skills.
All nine are rejected for unchanged use due consequential code correctness, synchronization, unsafe lifecycle or authority/privacy defects, not source reputation or a numerical quota.

Cross-package recurring defects: frame-count GPU retirement instead of fence completion, deterministic claims undermined by worker identity, unsafe allocator/handle lifetimes, and unbounded crash telemetry/remote tools.

Reference value remains: deterministic cooking, job DAGs, capability negotiation, SIMD/property tests, frame graphs, ECS scheduling, PAL interfaces; extraction must repair examples and preserve MIT notices.

Source-local nested game frontier now 23/23 candidate-terminal, but 198 other-shape source paths remain unclassified and 406 direct-shape paths remain without decisions. Ecosystem eligible distinct denominator remains unknown.
Candidate source-vetting scores are not governed verification pairs, package security scans, behavioral validation or unchanged-use approvals.
